Projects / Bidur–Trishuli

Emergency Response Project

A health and psychosocial response for communities affected by the flash flood/debris flood, with particular attention to older people and continuity of essential treatment.

Location
Ranabhumaneshwar School Holding Center, Sirkhali, Bidur Municipality–3, Nuwakot
Date
Bhadra 20, 2083
Status
Completed response

Response reach

  • 200People received health examination / consultation
  • 101Older persons — 48 women, 53 men
  • 60Older persons and family members receiving stress-management and psychosocial counselling

Following the flash flood and debris flood affecting communities around Lhende Khola–Bhotekoshi in Rasuwa, BIMBA Nepal joined Geriatric Society of Nepal and Art of Living Nepal in an emergency response.

Many affected older people had lost access to their regular medicines. For people living with chronic conditions, disruption of treatment can become an urgent health concern even without visible injury.

Services provided

  • Geriatric specialist examination and consultation
  • Orthopedic services
  • Cardiac testing
  • Dental services
  • Osteopathy
  • Trauma relief
  • Stress management
  • Psychosocial counselling
  • Necessary medicines and health materials

Medical support

Nepal APF Hospital / Armed Police Force, Balambu supported the response with a medical team including doctors deployed locally.

Emergency response is more than treating wounds. People affected by disaster also need human companionship, courage, empathy and hope.

The response reflected BIMBA Nepal’s belief that health support during emergencies should address both immediate medical needs and the emotional and social realities people face after disaster.
